purpose: Freeze the investigation scope, source boundaries, prohibited inference rules, and completion criteria for Banner Stage 1 before any census, schema finalization, or bulk asset work begins.

projectIntent.principle: Stage 1 investigates existing banner data units and source relationships. It does not create the final canonical banner schema.

knownInputs.role: Primary in-repository card-pool ConfigData candidate for Stage 1 census
Existing Korean replacement assets and verified legacy reusable banner mappings
Canonical Hero identity source for any Hero relation validation

knownInputs.source: legacy Korean guide / existing banner tables
knownInputs.role: Korean schedule history, display structure, terminology, and legacy management behavior
Defines required banner page families and intended consumer behavior

sourcePriorityPolicy: Reuse existing verified repository artifacts before reconstructing the same relationship from raw sources.
Use explicit ConfigData fields and IDs before names, numeric patterns, filenames, or visual similarity.
Use Hero relations through the existing Hero canonical identity layer; do not create a new name-based Hero join.
If Korean legacy data and current ConfigData disagree, record the discrepancy instead of overwriting either source.
Treat external/reference sources as read-only during Stage 1.
inScope: Identify all current banner-related source families to be censused in Stage 1-1.
Determine what kinds of records need investigation: banner definitions, occurrences, batches, pickup logs, selectable pools, event links, and asset references.
Record which existing generated or manual banner artifacts can be reused as checkpoints.
Define investigation status values so unknown structures can remain explicit rather than being guessed.
Define the boundary between raw/source evidence, investigation outputs, and later production consumers.
outOfScope: Final bannerId or canonical primary-key design
Full CardPool census or record counting
prohibitedInferences: Do not infer Hero relationships from Korean, Chinese, or English name similarity.
Do not infer release chronology from cardPoolId, bannerCode, patchCode, slotCode, Hero ID, asset filename, or file order unless a later stage verifies the rule.
Do not treat bannerCode as the final canonical bannerId during Stage 1.
Do not assume one existing table row equals one unique banner definition or one unique banner occurrence before the row-grain census.
Do not force every record into a known banner type; UNKNOWN and REVIEW must remain valid investigation states.
Do not invent missing start dates, end dates, events, selectable Hero lists, or asset mappings.
Do not overwrite or discard existing banner-overrides mappings while investigating raw sources.
completionCriteria: Known reusable banner artifacts are named and protected from unnecessary reconstruction.
Hero identity consumption rule is fixed to the existing canonical Hero ID layer.
Guess-based joins and chronology inference are explicitly prohibited.
Schema, asset extraction, and frontend work are explicitly deferred.
Stage 1-1 has a clear starting set of source families without requiring any Stage 1-0 data census.

nextStartPoint.firstPriority: Inventory existing repository banner-related artifacts and source families, beginning with existing verified/reusable artifacts before raw ConfigData expansion.
